c. 1949 December
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed notes by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, C. F. M. Cap.
DOGMA OF ASSUMPTION DIVINELY OPPORTUNE
TO RESCUE MEN'S HOPE IN THE SUPERNATURAL AND THEIR SOULS FROM DESPAIR.
Blessed be God in all His designs. Blessed be Jesus Christ, true God and true Man in his loving gratitude to Mary our heavenly Mother: -- His Mother, because she gave Him his human nature and stood by Him . to the END: our Mother because she has given him her Jesus, wholely to us, divine and human -- Jesus -- her First Born, our Eldest Brother; And next to Jesus Himself in merciful compassion standsout whateve our trouble, the never-failing Refuge of sinners, our life, our sweetness, our hope; our heavenly blessed Mother Mary.
Yea, therefore, blessed be, Jesus in the example (of divine perfection) He gives the rest of us His brethren -- Mary's 2nd borne -- the example at once, -- how we should love our individual mothers and, with Himself how to love Her whom from the Cross He so providentially bequethd as heavenly Mother to all His followers, whose faith in Him will permit his calling us His brethren. What a specticle to men and angels (The divine Son of God officially commending to His dearest Mother each one of us: "Woman; Behold thy son." Pleadingly to each one of us: "Behold thy Mother." What condescention on the part of Almighty God -- Second Person of the Blessed Trinity in His human nature and (as) the Son of Man -- Son of the Virgin Mary and thrty-three years before con- ceived by the Holy Ghost the Spirit of divine Love. What loyalty on Mary's part in the face of every opposition! What unshakable faith! What peerless, What incomparable confidence!
What a climax at once, as Mary, Mother of Redemption stood there at Calvary's first Altar, her own so Christ-like heart doublly pierced, -- what a climax at once, of loving sympathy and sorrow at once with her divine, Son-Victim freely dying to .
(Unfinished draft)
